Purple Pops
By: Fitness and Freebies
Published: Monday, July 9, 2012 - 6:04am

Ingredients




2 bananas -- ripe
6 ounces frozen purple grape juice concentrate
1/4 cup water
1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt
1 tablespoon sugar

Preparation

1 Puree all the ingredients and pour into small paper cups or Popsicle molds. 2 If using cups, when halfway frozen, stand a wooden stick or plastic spoon in the Popsicle to make a handle. When frozen solid, un-mold or peel away the paper to eat.

About

Cool, creamy and so delicious you won't have to push anyone to enjoy this healthful treat made with bananas, grape juice and nonfat yogurt.
